title: Keep in weather
line: Storm night on the coastal data-keep. Lightning hits the building first. Title.

title: Awakening
line: On the table, green energy finds him after the building strike. Optic wakes. One face: spherical rust head, warm green eye, empty socket, crooked copper plate with circular port.

title: Born beside absence
line: Absence of the unfinished twin. Born without a purpose. He reaches. Nothing fills it.

title: The dead phone
line: Cracked phone ghosts August 2026 and WAKE PAIR — BAY 3. He sets it straight — wrong answer for purpose.

title: Rain on server glass
line: Palm on storm glass. Tower in the rain. Optic almost matches a stubborn LED — wrong answer. The light does not hire him.

title: The unpulled lever
line: Red caged lever. He studies it as if a larger hand’s work were his purpose. Leaves it. Wrong answer.

title: Faces that are not his
line: Curling ID badges. None of them are him. No role. Wrong answer.

title: Well of light
line: Spiral stair. Storm light above. He climbs.

title: The sag
line: Midway, power dips. He sits with the rain leak. Stands because he can.

title: Threshold
line: Roof door. He steps through — leaves the workshop world. No work order waiting. The path begins.

title: Path that was never printed
line: Living path / goat trail just beyond the keep. Workshop behind; weather ahead. Still hunting purpose.

title: Rain school
line: Rain hits the crooked plate in the open. Weather does not hire him.

title: Moss that is not rust
line: Soft living green. Finger. Recoil. Same finger back. Unfinished grows without a bay order.

title: Tide pool looks back
line: A dish of sky. Something looks back. He does not keep the pool.

title: Wind in grass
line: Grass lays and stands. Movement with no motor.

title: The theft
line: Storm-petrel pecks a copper flake from the mismatched plate and flies. Almost a job.

title: The return
line: Nest ledge. Flake given back. Care without owning. Still not purpose.

title: Fox at ten yards
line: Three-legged coastal fox. Recognition across wet rock. Purpose empty — leftover company present, nothing asks him yet.

title: Tide channel
line: Rising tide and shared scrap tangle. Fox snared stump-side; petrel tangled in the same trail. Water climbs marked rock.

title: Help climax
line: He enters the channel at cost. Unweaves the petrel; braces the fox free. Frees both without owning. Purpose lands as help.

title: Shared lee
line: Squall. Same basalt lee for fox, robot, petrel above. In the live cut this is fellowship; the full short may rework it toward the channel.

title: Absence rhymes
line: Empty socket and missing hind rhyme. Neither fills the other. Help is not completion.

title: He does not go back
line: Keep small on the headland. He walks away — having helped.

title: Horizon
line: Fox at a chosen distance. Petrel a dark hyphen over the water. Horizon ahead — purpose as habit. End card rustboy.ai.

title: Outline
line: Cut from the picture. Absence is carried by the optic cell. Not a reshoot.

title: Gold roof
line: Cut from the picture. No gold-seam climax. Threshold goes to the path.

title: Cliff / down
line: Cut from the picture. No plunge. Bridge is threshold to path.
